package domain

import (
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"time"
)

const (
	LessonRevisionSchema       = "lesson-revision.v1"
	ActivityTheoryAcknowledged = "theory_acknowledged"
	ActivityQuizPassed         = "quiz_passed"
	ActivityPracticeCompleted  = "practice_completed"
	ActivityTaskPassed         = "task_passed"
)

type ActivitySourceReference struct {
	ID         string `json:"id"`
	RevisionID string `json:"revision_id,omitempty"`
}
type LessonActivity struct {
	ActivityID      string                  `json:"activity_id"`
	Type            string                  `json:"type"`
	Required        bool                    `json:"required"`
	SourceReference ActivitySourceReference `json:"source_reference"`
}

// LessonRevision is an immutable definition, never learner execution state.
type LessonRevision struct {
	Schema           string                `json:"schema"`
	LessonID         string                `json:"lesson_id"`
	LessonRevisionID string                `json:"lesson_revision_id"`
	Content          LessonRevisionContent `json:"content"`
	Activities       []LessonActivity      `json:"activities"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time             `json:"created_at"`
}
type LessonRevisionContent struct {
	Title        string               `json:"title"`
	Excerpt      string               `json:"excerpt"`
	Description  string               `json:"description"`
	Translations []LessonI18n         `json:"translations"`
	Tasks        []LessonRevisionTask `json:"tasks"`
	Examples     []LessonExample      `json:"examples"`
}

// Trusted snapshot includes keys. Only private transport may serialize it.
type LessonRevisionTask struct {
	Task         Task
	Tests        []TaskTest
	StarterFiles []TaskFileStorage
}

func ValidateLessonActivities(activities []LessonActivity) error {
	if len(activities) == 0 || len(activities) > 100 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	required := false
	for _, a := range activities {
		if !canonicalActivityUUID(a.ActivityID) || seen[a.ActivityID] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		seen[a.ActivityID] = true
		if !canonicalActivityUUID(a.SourceReference.ID) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		switch a.Type {
		case ActivityTheoryAcknowledged, ActivityQuizPassed, ActivityTaskPassed:
		case ActivityPracticeCompleted:
			if !canonicalActivityUUID(a.SourceReference.RevisionID) || a.SourceReference.ID != a.SourceReference.RevisionID {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		default:
			return ErrValidation
		}
		required = required || a.Required
	}
	if !required {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func canonicalActivityUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value && parsed != uuid.Nil
}
